@graph.name: 4 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Journey from Surabaya
@graph.description: Private 4-day East Java tour: Ijen crater, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, Bromo sunrise. All-inclusive — full East Java circuit from Surabaya.

@graph.name: Day 1: Surabaya to Bondowoso for Ijen Staging
@graph.description: The route opens with a transfer from Surabaya to the Bondowoso side so the Ijen segment can be handled properly. Screening is completed after hotel check-in before the climb window begins.

item.name: Surabaya to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Pickup by our team at your location in Surabaya. After meeting at the confirmed pick-up point, begin the overland transfer toward Bondowoso (Ijen area) as scheduled in the route plan.

item.name: Lunch at Local Restaurant
item.description: Stop at a local restaurant for lunch (cost not included). This is the planned meal break during the transfer, allowing time to order food and rest briefly before continuing to Bondowoso.

item.name: Local Restaurant to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Continue the overland journey from the restaurant toward Bondowoso, arriving in time for hotel check-in.

item.name: Check-in Bondowoso Hotel
item.description: Arrive in Bondowoso and complete the hotel check-in process. This step covers arrival at the accommodation and the basic check-in procedure so you can settle in after the transfer.

item.name: Ijen health screening
item.description: A health screening will be conducted by medical personnel directly at your hotel. This is a scheduled screening session as listed in the itinerary to complete the required check before the Ijen-area program.

item.name: Dinner at Accommodation
item.description: Dinner is served at the accommodation or a nearby restaurant (included). This is the planned dinner time after the transfer and screening, scheduled as an included meal for the day.

@graph.name: Day 2: Ijen Climb and Continue to the Papuma Side
@graph.description: After the Ijen sequence, the route moves south toward the Papuma side. This day establishes the broader East Java contrast that makes the package more than a volcano-only itinerary.

item.name: Ijen Tour
item.description: Take the Ijen tour. This block represents completing the scheduled Ijen program for the day, finished in full before the onward travel sequence to Jember and Papuma Beach.

item.name: Return to Bondowoso Hotel
item.description: Depart from the Ijen area after completing the hike and transfer back to the hotel in Bondowoso.

item.name: Ijen Hotel Check-out
item.description: Check out hotels in the Ijen area. This is the departure step from the Ijen-area accommodation after completing the Ijen tour block, transitioning to lunch and onward travel.

item.name: Lunch at Restaurant
item.description: Lunch at a local restaurant (included). This is the planned meal stop after check-out, providing time to eat before the transfer toward Jember.

item.name: Journey to Jember
item.description: Journey to Jember. This segment is the overland transfer from the Ijen-area base (Bondowoso City) to Jember as scheduled for the day’s long itinerary.

item.name: Jember Hotel Check-in
item.description: Arrive in Jember, check-in, then head straight to Papuma Beach. This step covers arriving at the Jember hotel, completing check-in efficiently, and continuing onward to the beach for the late-afternoon program.

item.name: Transfer to Papuma Beach
item.description: Depart from the Jember hotel and transfer to Papuma Beach in time for the sunset window.

item.name: Papuma Sunset Experience
item.description: Enjoying the sunset. This is the dedicated time window at Papuma Beach to relax, take photos, and experience the late-day atmosphere during sunset hour.

item.name: Return to Jember Hotel
item.description: Back to the hotel in Jember. This is the return transfer segment after the sunset stop, concluding the day’s coastal visit upon arrival back at the Jember accommodation.

@graph.name: Day 3: Papuma Area to Tumpak Sewu Staging
@graph.description: The third day keeps the route moving across East Java toward the Tumpak Sewu side. It should be understood as overland progression rather than as a light rest day between major stops.

item.name: Check out from hotel
item.description: Check out hotel. Complete the standard hotel check-out process in Jember, confirm departure readiness, and prepare for the early transfer toward the early Tumpak Sewu (Lumajang) area.

item.name: Journey to Tumpak Sewu
item.description: Transfer to Tumpak Sewu waterfall. Depart from the hotel in Jember and begin the direct overland drive to the Tumpak Sewu area, using the allocated travel window for the point-to-point transfer.

item.name: Explore Tumpak Sewu Waterfall
item.description: Arrive at the Tumpak Sewu area (Lumajang), and explore Tumpak Sewu Waterfall. Use this activity block for the on-site waterfall experience in the Tumpak Sewu area, following the planned visit duration for exploration and viewing as scheduled.

item.name: Lunch
item.description: Finish explore Tumpak Sewu and having lunch at local warung in Tumpak Sewu area

item.name: Transfer to Bromo
item.description: Transfer to hotel in Bromo area

@graph.name: Day 4: Tumpak Sewu, Bromo Sequence, and Return to Surabaya
@graph.description: The final day combines the Tumpak Sewu segment with the Bromo-side finish before returning to Surabaya. It is a productive closing day that works best for travelers who accept a compact but serious route rhythm.

item.name: Bromo Jeep Tour Experience
item.description: Starting the Bromo Jeep tour. Begin the sunrise tour sequence by Jeep in the Mount Bromo area, following the planned route flow for the morning program.

item.name: Hotel Breakfast
item.description: Back to the hotel for breakfast. Return from the Bromo morning program to the hotel and take a short breakfast break before check-out and departure.

item.name: Bromo Hotel Check-out
item.description: Check-out from the hotel. Complete the hotel check-out process and prepare for the overland transfer to Surabaya.

item.name: Transfer to Surabaya
item.description: Journey to Surabaya. Start the road transfer from the Bromo area to Surabaya as scheduled, concluding the Bromo segment for the day.

item.name: Finish at Surabaya City
item.description: Arrive in Surabaya and proceed with the final transfer to your requested drop-off (hotel/airport). Tour ends after drop-off completion.

@graph.reviewBody:
We have such a wonderful moments
Even in the bad weather ,anyway we can enjoy the trip. All The guides are very kindness, friendly and sincerely especially Yandi and Rendi , two thumbs up!!!!!!

Rendi&yandi good guide
Rendi&yandi good guide

It was a very fun trip
It was a very fun trip. The driver, Yandi, took great care of us the whole time and brought us everywhere we wanted to go. The guides, Rendi and Yandi, communicated well in English and helped take really great photos. If you’re planning to travel to Surabaya, I highly recommend this place.

Ahboy was an amazing guide.
Ahboy was an amazing guide- knowledgeable, caring and fun. Wr're so glad he showed us ljen.

Amazing trip
Had an amazing trip visiting Bromo, Ijen Crater, and Tumpak Sewu Waterfall! Everything was well organized and the price was really good. The staff were super kind and helpful — special thanks to Yandi (our driver who’s been staying with us the whole trip) and Boy (our guide to Ijen crater). They were so friendly and shared lots of useful info. Even though we had to wake up in the middle of the night, it was totally worth it! Highly recommended

Incredible experience! We did 4D3N and they delivered on everything that was promised. We found this tour company very honest compared to others because you know the hotels that you'll go to (which are great btw).\nOur driver, Yandi, was always very kind and attentive. He never rushed us, letting us take our time to rest, while always staying on schedule. He also brought us to have lunch and dinner in very nice restaurants with very reasonable prices. And he even secured us some great spots to see the sunrise in Bromo. Most importantly, mainly thanks to him, we were literally one of the first to reach Tumpak Sewu, Bromo and Ijen, so we could enjoy them without big crowds. Big thanks to Anjas too for being a super nice guide and helping us a lot in Ijen!\nYou should really consider this tour company if you wanna visit these amazing natural treasures in East Java!

Our trip with Java Volcano Tour was amazing! Big thanks to our guide Pras—friendly, funny, and speaking great English. He quickly helped me find my lost backpack and even took beautiful photos for us. With his help, we could just relax and enjoy Ijen's blue lake, Papuma's sunset, Tumpak Sewu's power, and Bromo's sunrise. Truly unforgettable!
On a vécu une superbe expérience avec Oboy qui nous a guidé tout le long du voyage. L'expérience était vraiment top! Je recommande Oboy, qui a vraiment été au petit soin pour nous.

The 4D3N volcano trip is really worth going!!

We joined the tour from 31/7 to 3/8. We have had a great trip with our driver, Dika, he was being very helpful and caring, sharing things about Indonesia with us, taking us to different local and good restaurants, and also taking good care of us. He also provided flexibility for us to decide our schedules, I highly appreciate his professionalism!!

Besides, for the Ijen tour, our guide, Rendi, also helped us a lot, he kept asking about our condition when we went up the mountain so that we were able to rest at any time. When we went down the steep crater, he held our hands to prevent us from falling. I like his energy that makes our journey so happy and memorable!

Overall, a great experience! We booked the 4D3N Ijen, Papuma, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo tour (with the Madakaripura Waterfall add-on). Our guide, Gufron, was fun, communicative, and always willing to share interesting facts—plus, we bonded over our shared taste in music, which made the trip even more memorable. The driver was also great and drove very steadily, so we always felt safe.\n\nThe itinerary is quite packed and can be tiring, but every attraction is absolutely worth it. Just a small tip: make sure to bring a good pair of hiking shoes for Ijen! Highly recommended!
We booked 4d3n ijen-tumpak sewu-bromo- it was arranged smoothly from the airport till bck to hotel on the last day- the teams are very professional.

Our guide is Pras and he is so friendly and helpful throughout the 4D3N. He even bring us out to eat local food because we didn't want to eat the hotel food. He also take so many pictures of us and is a very good driver. We feel very safe and well-taken care of. Thank you & see you again!

We did 4D3N from Bali to Surabaya visiting Mount Ijen, Bromo, Tumpak Sewu and Madakaripura Waterfall and we cannot be so grateful!\n\nEverything went perfect, and our driver Yandi help us with everything! The local guides were also amazing! And the hotels perfect!
We did 4D3N from Bali to Surabaya visiting Mount Ijen, Bromo, Tumpak Sewu and Madakaripura Waterfall and we cannot be so grateful! Everything went perfect.

a pleasant trip during 4D 3N exploring East Java Ijen Crater, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu, Bromo accompanied by a professional guide who always cares about customers. Good job JVTO. I will recommend to my friends

We had a fantastic trip to Bromo and Tumpak Sewu with JVTO and Gufron as our tour guide. We were picked up on time from the airport and was ferried to all the location in comfort. The whole tour is also accommodating and flexible - when we need to stop for break/quick snack purchase - it was always being accommodated

The operator responses for every questions and queries was also very fast and fantastic. when there was an issue (eg: the Ijen closure), the operators assisted in offering alternatives.

Definitely highly recommended!
Bromo - Tumpak sewu. Stunning natural places that you must visit if you are in East Java. Highly recommend this tour service.

We had an incredible journey with JVTO during our recent trip to Tempak Sewu Waterfall and Mount Bromo! From the moment we embarked, everything was meticulously planned and executed flawlessly. Our tour guide, Rendi, and driver, Gean, were exceptional. They were not only proficient in English but also engaged us in enriching conversations throughout the trip.
Initially, our itinerary included a visit to Mount Ijen. However, due to increased volcanic activity, JVTO swiftly offered us alternative destinations. We opted to explore Tempak Sewu Waterfall, and it turned out to be a breathtaking experience that exceeded our expectations.

Overall, our experience with JVTO was outstanding, and we wholeheartedly recommend their services to fellow travelers. We're already looking forward to booking another tour with JVTO in the future, particularly to visit Mount Ijen once conditions allow.

Would thoroughly recommend this tour, enjoyed every minute. Unfortunately Ijen was closed the day before we were due to start but Tumpak Sewu Waterfall was offered as an alternative which was also amazing. Accommodation was very nice and Juan was a great tour guide. Thank you again!  Will and Helena

Last week my friend and I had the pleasure of visiting Ijen Crater, Tumpak Sewu Waterfall and Mt. Bromo. It was definitely a memorable trip.
A significant part of what made this trip enjoyable was our driver cum guide, Johan. Firstly he was always on time and he also made sure we had ample time for travelling between different destinations. Most importantly, there was always more than enough time for photography. His friendly demeanor and expert guidance helped us navigate the crowds and get the best spots for pictures.
Alfi Layalin was the guide attached to us throughout our hike at Ijen Crater. She patiently hiked with us up and down the mountain and gently guided us along the rocky paths. She also took beautiful pictures for us.
Gawan Sulis was our guide at the waterfall. He never hesitated to lend his arm for us to hold on to as we climb up and down the slippery route.
For anyone looking to explore these parts of Indonesia, we highly recommend Java Volcano Tour Operator. The stunning views on top of the expert guidances made this trip truly unforgettable. 👍👍👍
